verdict.rationale: An llms.txt file does exist and returns HTTP 200 with agent-oriented doc links, but the same probe evidence shows those links point to a pre-restructure path structure that now 404s, and per-page markdown mirrors (.md) and machine-readable OpenAPI specs are not served — so an agent pointed at llms.txt would hit broken references rather than a reliable agent-native doc surface. missing for 10: up-to-date/working llms.txt links, per-page .md mirrors, OpenAPI/machine-readable spec discoverability, independent confirmation an agent successfully used it end-to-end.
